source_discovery: Daily research automation proposes source-card updates; runner uses reviewed OpenAI manifest snapshots and does not crawl. Separately attributed robotics references are advisory until explicitly admitted to the worker evidence set.

sources.title: Learning from human preferences
sources.finding: Human judgments between behavior clips guide a learned reward; uncertain comparisons inform further feedback.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Collect consented pairwise robot-behavior judgments; retain ties, abstentions, rater disagreement and delayed outcomes.

sources.title: Learning dexterity
sources.finding: Dactyl learned control in randomized simulation and was tested on a physical robot.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Vary friction, lighting, geometry, latency and wear in simulation; validate transfer separately on real robots.

sources.title: Solving Rubik’s Cube with a robot hand
sources.finding: Automatic domain randomization expanded training-environment variation as the system improved.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Expand stress-test ranges only after predefined simulated performance checks; never equate simulated time with residence time.

sources.title: Aligning language models to follow instructions
sources.finding: Human demonstrations and output comparisons supported supervised training and reward-model-based optimization.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Keep high-quality demonstrations, corrections and real-human preference pairs in separate, purpose-authorized datasets.

sources.title: Learning to play Minecraft with Video PreTraining
sources.finding: Action-labeled contractor recordings trained an inverse-dynamics model used to label additional video.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Explore action inference from permissioned robot video; mark inferred actions as weak labels, not sensor ground truth.

sources.title: OpenAI Red Teaming Network
sources.finding: External domain specialists contributed risk taxonomies and adversarial evaluation across development stages.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Maintain independent safety reviewers and a failure-to-regression-test queue; bot review cannot issue certification.

sources.title: OpenAI Data Partnerships
sources.finding: The program described public and private dataset partnerships, curation and access controls.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Arrange explicit-purpose data contributions from labs, manufacturers and consenting participants; no agreement is implied.

sources.title: Sycophancy in GPT-4o
sources.finding: OpenAI reported that overemphasis on short-term feedback contributed to overly agreeable behavior.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Measure lasting benefit, burden and freedom to reject; do not reward flattery, dependency or distress at withdrawal.

sources.title: Evaluation best practices
sources.finding: The guide advocates production-relevant cases, human calibration, logging and evaluation as systems change.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Mine verified failures into versioned regression suites; protect sealed holdouts and a frozen official scoring protocol.

sources.title: Learning to summarize with human feedback
sources.finding: OpenAI used pairwise human comparisons and invested in labeler onboarding, clear quality definitions, ongoing support, and monitoring researcher-labeler agreement; it also documented reward-model overoptimization.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Treat rater training, agreement monitoring, disagreement analysis, and post-optimization human checks as first-class quality controls for robot preference and assistance labels.

sources.title: Improving Model Safety Behavior with Rule-Based Rewards
sources.finding: Rule-Based Rewards encode desired safety behavior into programmatic reward signals to reduce reliance on repeated human labeling for routine safety cases.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Use machine-checkable rules for development-only safety regression tests where the rule is explicit, while preserving human adjudication and non-compensatory safety gates for field certification.

sources.title: Collective alignment: public input on our Model Spec
sources.finding: OpenAI collected ranked responses and written justifications from more than 1,000 participants, used both human-first and automated proposal loops, and retained internal review before adopting changes.
sources.hilo_adaptation: For coexistence norms, sample diverse participants, preserve rationales and subgroup disagreement, and require human review before converting observed preferences into benchmark-policy changes.

sources.title: OpenAI Economic Research Exchange
sources.finding: OpenAI describes scoped external research collaborations using privacy-preserving analysis of product and usage data together with customer and institutional partnerships.
sources.hilo_adaptation: For longitudinal robot research, define scoped research questions and privacy-preserving access before exposing usage telemetry to external researchers; research access is not publication or training permission.

reference_sources.title: 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge
reference_sources.finding: The 2026 challenge reports 20,000 human teleoperation demonstrations totaling 1,950 hours with RGB/depth observations, proprioception, actions, and skill/subtask annotations for 100 long-horizon household tasks.
reference_sources.hilo_adaptation: Use synchronized multimodal demonstration records and explicit subtask annotations as a development-data pattern, while keeping simulated teleoperation hours separate from real WANTED resident hours.

reference_sources.title: Pragmatic Embodied Spoken Instruction Following in Human-Robot Collaboration with Theory of Mind
reference_sources.finding: The work evaluates spoken instruction following under noisy speech in both simulation and real-world human-robot collaborative settings with human evaluations.
reference_sources.hilo_adaptation: Include noisy, ambiguous speech and collaborative context in human-robot communication tests; score clarification and safe fallback behavior rather than assuming perfect transcripts.

reference_sources.title: On-body textile hysteresis estimation for personalized physical human-robot interaction
reference_sources.finding: The study reports individualized on-body calibration from about 90 seconds of data and evaluates the method with 12 human participants and an articulated mannequin.
reference_sources.hilo_adaptation: Track calibration burden and participant-specific adaptation separately from generic task success, and require held-out evaluation after personalization.

reference_sources.title: Goal Oriented Autonomous Long Lived Systems Research
reference_sources.finding: The GOALS Lab studies mobile robots operating for days, weeks, or months in dynamic uncertain environments, online model updating, uncertainty-aware planning, and switching between autonomous and human control.
reference_sources.hilo_adaptation: Make online adaptation, uncertainty tracking, and transitions between autonomy and human assistance explicit longitudinal diagnostics rather than hidden support.

reference_sources.title: Isaac Sim - Robotics Simulation and Synthetic Data Generation
reference_sources.finding: Isaac Sim supports physically based robotics simulation, controllable synthetic-data generation, real-world capture ingestion, and software- or hardware-in-the-loop validation.
reference_sources.hilo_adaptation: Use simulator provenance and parameterized perturbations for preflight and regression suites; require separate physical validation before any field-performance claim.

reference_sources.title: Isaac Lab-Arena
reference_sources.finding: Isaac Lab-Arena provides APIs for curating and diversifying robot-evaluation tasks and running large-scale parallel simulation evaluations across embodiments, objects, and environments.
reference_sources.hilo_adaptation: Use it as an optional digital-twin execution substrate for reproducible stress suites, without treating parallel simulation counts as independent human evidence.

reference_sources.title: Introducing Index: Building The World’s Largest and Most Diverse Physical Dataset
reference_sources.finding: Figure describes a human video collection pipeline with automated quality filters, human fraud review, embedding-based deduplication, task and cluster rebalancing, and hierarchical annotation.
reference_sources.hilo_adaptation: Adopt explicit quality, fraud, deduplication, diversity-balance, and annotation stages for permissioned HILO development data, while independently verifying rights and never converting contributor video into resident-hour evidence.

reference_sources.title: NEO Home Robot
reference_sources.finding: 1X publicly describes autonomous operation with scheduled Expert Mode for guided tasks, remote control, memory-based personalization, self-charging, and home-focused safety features.
reference_sources.hilo_adaptation: Require every remote expert, remote-control, and rescue interval to be disclosed as assistance burden, and separate personalization memory from consent and privacy authorization.
